bib.title: Augmenting Language Models with Long-Term Memory

question: How can a pretrained LLM use an unbounded cache of past context without suffering memory staleness or catastrophic forgetting?
hypothesis: A frozen backbone that encodes memory, paired with a trainable residual side network that retrieves and reads it, avoids staleness and beats coupled-memory (MemTRM) and sparse-attention baselines.
contributions: Decoupled architecture: frozen backbone LLM as memory encoder, residual SideNet as retriever and reader
Cross-network residual connections from backbone to SideNet
Token-to-chunk retrieval over a cached K/V memory bank up to 65k tokens
Memory-augmented in-context learning with thousands of demonstrations in memory

method.summary: A frozen GPT-2-style backbone caches layer-18 attention keys/values of previous segments in a FIFO bank; a 12-layer SideNet initialised from the backbone, with one memory-augmented joint-attention layer, retrieves top-K chunks by dot product and is trained on 26B tokens with next-token loss. Evaluated zero-shot on PG-22, ArXiv, ChapterBreak and memory-augmented ICL.
method.task: long-context language modeling, suffix identification, in-context classification and QA

datasets.name: Subset of the Pile (BookCorpus2, Books3, OpenWebText2, Stack Exchange, Wikipedia, Gutenberg PG-19, NIH ExPorter, Pile-CC)
datasets.preprocessing: Batchfying: documents split into batch-size groups, shuffled within group, concatenated and cut into ordered segments so consecutive segments of a document sit in consecutive batches; no global shuffle

datasets.name: PG-22
datasets.source: Project Gutenberg books published 2020-2022, crawled and cleaned by authors

datasets.name: ChapterBreak AO3
datasets.preprocessing: for models without memory, the front of the prefix is dropped to fit input length

datasets.name: SST-2, MR, Subj, SST-5, MPQA
datasets.size: 2000 extra demonstrations sampled from train and loaded into memory

models.name: GPT-2* (reproduced backbone)
models.architecture: decoder-only transformer with Alibi position embeddings, untied embeddings
models.init_from: trained from scratch by authors, 117B tokens, batch 512, seq 1024

models.name: LongMem (SideNet + frozen backbone)
models.architecture: residual SideNet, memory layer is SideNet layer 9, reads K/V cached from backbone layer 18
models.init_from: SideNet layer l initialised from backbone layer 2l; embeddings and LM head frozen and shared

models.name: MemTRM (Memorizing Transformer, reproduced)
models.architecture: knn-augmented layer at layer 18 of the backbone

other.training: same tokens and hyperparameters as LongMem

other.note: numbers cited from STI22, not rerun

training.objective: standard left-to-right next-token likelihood; only SideNet (except embeddings and LM head) trained, backbone frozen

other.evidence_note: inferred: adaptation seq/hardware from Appendix B applies to both stages

inference.decoding: greedy for ICL label/answer generation; perplexity scoring for ChapterBreak
inference.samples: ICL: mean and std over 6 runs with different random seeds for demonstration selection; LM and ChapterBreak: single evaluation
inference.prompting: fixed templates, demos concatenated with newlines (Appendix C)
inference.retrieval: token-to-chunk, exact faiss GPU inner-product index of mean-pooled chunk keys, top K/csz chunks per token, per-GPU index

parameters.memory_layer: SideNet layer 9, keys/values from backbone layer 18

metrics.name: suffix identification accuracy
metrics.definition: candidate suffix with lowest perplexity chosen as label

eval.protocol: 6 seeds for ICL; no seeds or significance test for LM and ChapterBreak

evidence.quote: The training for memory-augmented adaptation iterates on 26B tokens, with a global 256 batch-size and 1024 sequence length.

limits: No limitations section. Only a 407M GPT-2-style backbone with Alibi; one training run, no seeds for LM and ChapterBreak results.
Baselines other than GPT-2* and MemTRM are cited from Sun et al. and differ in size and context, so the GPT-3 comparison is indirect.
Memory is attention K/V vectors, requires white-box access to the backbone; not an agent or text memory.
Memory size was set by test-time ablation on PG-22; chunk size chosen on SST-2 validation set.
ICL variance is large (std up to 14 points).

terms.definition: frozen backbone LLM encodes memory; a separate SideNet retrieves and fuses it, avoiding memory staleness
cached older representations may have distributional shifts from those from the latest model as parameters update

lineage.note: coupled memory; joint attention fusion adopted from it
side network idea; new objective and cross-network residuals
